summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a change in the record date for ADS holders' entitlement to vote at a Share Scheme Meeting scheduled for May 29, 2026. The record date was moved forward to May 13, 2026, from May 21, 2026, to allow BNY Mellon, as Depositary, sufficient time to collect voting instructions. The filing mentions a share scheme, which suggests that the event relates to a potential acquisition or corporate action involving ADS holders' voting rights, but the specific terms of any deal are not provided. Further details on the share scheme are expected.
